contexts: fire service visits made on request
winter fieldwork window ending in March
reading: Tenure and heating type shape both the risk of carbon monoxide exposure and the chance of having a working alarm, while the only existing local data (fire service visits) come from households who ask. A probability sample from the property roll with verification at the door is the only way to see the households the current programme misses. Self-report is the main measurement trap, and one model lead tried to pass a retrieved national survey off as a landmark with an invented identifier.
